title_en: Interpretation of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Article 53, Paragraph 2 of the Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en:
The Fifteenth Session of the Standing Committee of the Tenth National People's Congress deliberated the proposal submitted by the State Council requesting an interpretation of paragraph 2 of Article 53 of the Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China. Pursuant to the provisions of Item 4 of Article 67 of the Constitution of the People's Republic of China and paragraph 1 of Article 158 of the Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China, and after consulting the Committee for the Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region under the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress hereby gives the following interpretation of the provisions of paragraph 2 of Article 53 of the Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China:
Paragraph 2 of Article 53 of the Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China provides: "If the Chief Executive is vacated, a new Chief Executive shall be selected within six months in accordance with the provisions of Article 45 of this Law." The phrase "selected in accordance with the provisions of Article 45 of this Law" includes both that a new Chief Executive shall be selected pursuant to the method of selection prescribed in Article 45 of the Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China, and that the term of office of the new Chief Executive shall be determined pursuant to the method of selection prescribed in Article 45 of the Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China.
Paragraph 3 of Article 45 of the Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China provides: "The specific method for selecting the Chief Executive shall be prescribed by Annex I 'Method for the Selection of the Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region'." Article 1 of Annex I provides: "The Chief Executive shall be selected by a broadly representative Election Committee in accordance with this Law and appointed by the Central People's Government." Article 2 provides: "The term of office of the Election Committee shall be five years." Article 7 provides: "If it is necessary to amend the method for selecting the Chief Executive for terms subsequent to the year 2007, such amendments shall be passed by a two-thirds majority of all the members of the Legislative Council, with the consent of the Chief Executive, and shall be reported to the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress for approval." The above provisions indicate that prior to the year 2007, under the institutional arrangement whereby the Chief Executive is selected by an Election Committee with a five-year term, if the Chief Executive fails to complete the five-year term prescribed in Article 46 of the Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China, resulting in the vacancy of the office of Chief Executive, the term of office of the new Chief Executive shall be the remaining term of the original Chief Executive; after the year 2007, if amendments are made to the aforesaid method for selecting the Chief Executive, in the event that the office of Chief Executive becomes vacant, the term of office of the new Chief Executive shall be determined in accordance with the amended specific method for selecting the Chief Executive.
It is hereby announced.
